title: Two-function hypercontractive inequality
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $r,s,\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $r>0$, $s>0$, $rs\le1$, $0\le\rho\le1$, and $\rho^2\le rs$. For any real-valued functions $f,g$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, their uniform inner product with the noise operator applied to $g$ satisfies
\[
\langle f,T_\rho g\rangle\le \bigl(\E|f|^{1+r}\bigr)^{1/(1+r)}\bigl(\E|g|^{1+s}\bigr)^{1/(1+s)}.
\]
